page_copy.pattern: Framer's native CMS capabilities combined with Notion's database flexibility created an opportunity to build a fully automated content publishing system. The architecture needed to support three distinct content types—AI-generated podcast analysis blogs, fashion lookbook spreads, and e-commerce product listings—while maintaining visual cohesion through Bauhaus-inspired geometric design elements.
page_copy.action: Developed a single reusable Framer component connected to a Notion database that dynamically populates content across all three sections. Integrated Notion-to-Framer automation for seamless publishing workflows, designed custom micro-interactions using geometric shapes that respond to user engagement, and built out a 500+ item print shop with automated inventory management. The design system uses bold geometric forms and a limited color palette to create visual hierarchy while keeping load times minimal.
page_copy.measured: Successfully automated the publishing pipeline for 200+ weekly AI-generated blog posts analyzing podcast content from multiple series. The single-component architecture reduced development time by 70% compared to traditional multi-page builds, while the Notion integration eliminated manual content entry entirely. The fashion lookbook section showcases 81 images through dynamic CMS population, and the print shop maintains real-time inventory across the automated system.
